shorts_extract.hook: Why do adults swear they can HEAR better at a loud dinner table the second they put their glasses on? A 1976 dubbing accident caught your eyes rewriting your ears.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: McGurk & MacDonald (1976 Nature, N=103: 59% kids -> 98% adults hear 'DA') + Nath & Beauchamp (2012) temporal lobe STS + Meijer & Noppeney (2023).
shorts_extract.twist: Knowing the trick gives zero immunity — covering the screen flips 'DA' right back into 'BA' because lips lead sound by 100 milliseconds.
